sceneConcept: A neat forty-year-old Chinese underground boxing-venue staff member stands alone against a transparent background. A black buzz cut, brown eyes, one short shallow scar across his right cheek and a knowing friendly smile distinguish him. He wears a crisp white collared shirt with sleeves rolled evenly, a fitted grey sweater vest, black trousers, a plain belt and polished black shoes. One small red five-petal flower handmade from folded paper sits clearly in his left breast pocket. His left hand rests in a trouser pocket while his right hand hangs relaxed and open. Soft even frontal studio light keeps him clearly administrative rather than combative. Visual refresh: a dark waistcoat over a rolled blue shirt with the small paper flower retained.
